limits: Engineering corpus and package pins; selected testnet launch pins remain pending.
Unknown initial ancestry/ABI state; no current/head ABI fallback or seeded frontier.
Primary deletion is a history tombstone; contract_state is disabled and actual state deletion remains unqualified.
No observed secondary update/deletion, fork/reconnect, full-width source sequence, Rust/offline or Bun runtime qualification.
Legacy decimal sequence fields only; no gated full-range storage, public admission/sink/PIT activation or retained-history upgrade claim.
Three startup bulk items report one acknowledged copy in each run; later physical-copy equality does not establish universal two-copy acknowledgments.

Each physical read independently passes the same logical/source assertions. Whole-document digests include unsorted result structures and differ for one Node22 copy; no normalized byte-equality claim is made.
Qualifier-supervised clean process exits do not establish production graceful checkpoint/restart or power-loss recovery.
Observer, repeated source graph reads and bulk ledger add overhead; durations are not throughput measurements.
